# Changelog

## 2026-11

- Added field guidance from HashiCorp Professional Services delivery engagements to the following pages:
  - Organizing resources: naming schema, single-organization mapping, owners-team break-glass access, variable set credentials and precedence, and repository-to-workspace mapping
  - Identity and access management: Entra ID and Okta team mapping, user offboarding, automation tokens, and VCS connectivity issues
  - Policy as code and Sentinel management: policy checks versus policy evaluations, and field policy patterns
  - Self-hosted agents: agent sizing, pool identity, and internal OIDC options
  - Private registry management: module authoring standards
  - Audit log management: audit trail collection patterns
  - No-code provisioning management: service catalog trade-offs
- Published the Consumer onboarding and Upgrade procedures pages
- Updated credits and contributors
